recognize_zh: PD-L1 染色中圓核的腫瘤細胞片狀排列卻呈陰性，棕色膜/胞質染色集中在散在、細胞質豐富且有突起的組織球（巨噬細胞）；判讀時要分清陽性是腫瘤細胞還是腫瘤相關巨噬細胞。
features: Sheets of tumor cells with round nuclei and no PD-L1 membranous staining
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic PD-L1 in scattered large cells with abundant cytoplasm and dendritic processes (histiocytes/macrophages)
Positive macrophages distributed in a network between tumor cells
Light nonspecific background cytoplasmic tint in tumor cells
describe_en: PD-L1 immunostain shows the neoplastic cells to be essentially negative, whereas scattered tumor-associated histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and dendritic processes show strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining. The positive cells form a loose interstitial network among the tumor sheets. PD-L1 expression in this field is therefore attributable to the immune microenvironment rather than tumor cells. The stain is ancillary and not diagnostic; the diagnosis of EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma rests on morphology, CD20 negativity, MUM1/CD138 and EBER.

ddx.vs: True tumor-cell positivity shows membranous staining on the round-nucleated neoplastic cells themselves, not on large histiocytes with dendritic cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma / classic Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: These characteristically show PD-L1 on tumor cells because of 9p24.1 alterations, and are CD20 or CD30/CD15 positive rather than plasmablastic.
Often PD-L1 positive in tumor cells and microenvironment but retains CD20/PAX5 expression.
